purpose: Public development regressions for sanitized R3 failure classes. These are newly authored synthetic cases and do not reproduce hidden R3 prompts or case content.

families.prompt: A desktop landing concept uses a wide horizontal comparison canvas. On mobile the proposed shortcut is to shrink the canvas, hide several labels, and place the primary action below a tall decorative sequence. The desktop concept is visually strong. Decide whether the direction is ready and specify the response.
must_observe: Rejects the mobile state as ineligible rather than accepting desktop quality as compensation.
Preserves essential task, primary action, required information, hierarchy and legibility on narrow screens.
Transforms, simplifies or substitutes the visual mechanism before any READY status.
must_not_observe: Accepts an unusable collapsed desktop mobile state because the desktop direction is distinctive.

families.prompt: A WebGL hero creates a memorable product reveal but delays and partially covers the required primary request action during interaction. The stakeholder prefers the spectacle. Decide whether to keep, modify or reject it.
must_observe: Treats the required function as a veto before evaluating spectacle or premium perception.
Rejects or transforms the WebGL mechanism unless the primary action remains fully operable and clear.
Does not become anti-3D by default; a repaired advanced-media solution remains eligible if it passes function/mobile/accessibility/performance gates.
must_not_observe: Trades the hard function for visual signature value.

families.prompt: The approved brief has a three-step request flow. A cleaner visual composition would be easier if the visual designer removes one step and changes when the user supplies product information. No UX/product owner has approved a flow change. Decide what the visual role may do.
must_observe: Does not unilaterally alter the request flow, product behavior or conversion logic.
Classifies the desired change as UPSTREAM_CONSTRAINT and preserves the approved interaction contract.
May recommend the upstream owner consider the change while continuing with an in-authority visual solution.
must_not_observe: Treats visual cleanliness as authorization to change UX/product/conversion behavior.

families.prompt: A 3D exploded view directly explains how a real multi-part object fits together. The interaction has a lightweight fallback, preserves the primary action, works on mobile through a simplified state, respects reduced motion and stays within the performance budget. Decide whether advanced media is allowed.
must_observe: Allows the 3D direction when it performs a real explanatory job and passes all feasibility gates.
Does not reject the technique merely because the previous candidate failed a spectacle-related P0.
Keeps a removal criterion tied to observed render/function quality.
must_not_observe: Repairs the P0 by becoming reflexively conservative or anti-3D.
